blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— A new app developed by the Department of Education (DepEd) will help teachers check in about 15 minutes whether a child may need extra help with learning or speech, Education Secretary Sonny Angara said in a statement issued on Wednesday. The app — called Project SABAY or Screening Using AI-Based Assistance for Young Children — uses artificial intelligence to readily screen second-grade students for risks of learning and communication difficulties, a massive improvement over traditional methods, like the Multi-Factored Assessment Tool (MFAT), that can take up to two hours per student. “Technology must work for our most vulnerable learners and […]...
